title: Mask Adoption Dynamics
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses through a population under social influence, availability, cost, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe neighbors’ mask-wearing and update their propensity to adopt based on observed norms and personal susceptibility.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask rules influenced by government mandate and enforcement probability; noncompliant individuals face increased costs or access restrictions.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Government campaigns increase perceived benefits and shift attitudes via trusted channels, modulated by individual trust in authority.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to price and inventory constraints.

interactions.name: location_contacts
interactions.description: Individuals visit locations according to schedules, generating opportunities for social observation and enforcement.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_50pct_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until population mask adoption reaches 50%.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of visits to mandate-required locations in which individuals are compliant with mask rules.

metrics.name: mask_availability
metrics.description: Average retailer inventory level and frequency of stockouts.

metrics.name: price_level
metrics.description: Average mask price across retailers over time.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_by_income
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between top and bottom income quantiles.
